## Design decisions recorded at implementation

Full rulings in ADR-0311; the load-bearing ones:

- **Judged = declaration + caller-supplied verdict.** The
  kernel never calls a model (`offline-only`); `check_judged`
 /`admit_hosted` validate a caller-supplied `Verdict`
  against the declaration — authority is detector-bound
  (deterministic ⇒ `kernel`, judged ⇒ `delegate`, human ⇒
  `principal`). `Verdict` gains additive `bundle_id`,
  `calibration_ref`, `independence_summary`,
  `uncited_findings` (CC8).
- **`ModelIo` gates every judged class.** `na_classes`
  renders all six C2 classes `n/a{class}` unless `ModelIo`
  is in the participant's observability set — an
  `end_state`-only host gets honest n/a rows, never an
  unsupported divergence verdict (a first cut treated
  `EndState` as sufficient; the `na_table` test caught it).
- **`hold_admissible()` is the only gate read.** Judged
  records annotate and feed back; they never independently
  hold or veto a `stop{completed}` — deterministic records
  carry the hold.
- **Unprovenanced driver rows mint `kernel` authority.**
  Driver-emitted rows carry no `provenance` record but are
  kernel-produced (`producer.component_class = kernel`);
  the projection confers `kernel` on those and leaves all
  other unprovenanced rows `unverified` — without the mint
  the D7 `censored_evidence` detector could never see a
  refused-effect row.
- **`probe` is read-only and closed-world.**
  `admit_probe` refuses undeclared capabilities, non-read
  capability classes and the prohibited-domain list;
  `reconcile_probe` dispatches each probe through
  `ProbePort` as an ordinary charged effect, joins the
  returned handles, and a denied probe downgrades any
  `agree` to `unverifiable`.
- **Feedback is per-turn deduplicated.** The driver emits
  `context.artefact.delivered{kind = kernel_notice}` at
  `kernel` authority — one per `(class, subject)` per turn
  via `feed_back_notices`; repeated holds across turns
  re-notify each turn by construction.
- **`control.critic.gated`** is a registered ledger class
  (`led`, events-observable) — the critic-gate audit row;
  its payload is `critic_gated_payload` (rule ref, verdict
  count, gate outcome).

## Removability

`removability(0…3)` green (serial script run). The C2
reconciler is opt-in: `DriverConfig.reconciler = None`
reproduces the byte-identical C0 `reconcile_ledger_only`
path (`disabled_reconciler_is_byte_identical_c0`);
`disable_gamma_recipe` documents the tier-ablation recipe.
No new feature-gate stanzas needed — no new crate.
